source_routes.paper_title: Association of Helicobacter pylori infection with survival outcomes in advanced gastric cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors

source_routes.paper_title: Targeting PD-L2/RGMb overcomes microbiome-related immunotherapy resistance

source_routes.paper_title: Immune checkpoint blockade resistance in lung cancer: emerging mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities

source_routes.paper_title: Five-year survival outcomes in NSCLC patients with concurrent GERD on proton pump inhibitors receiving pembrolizumab or nivolumab: A global study.

source_routes.paper_title: Friends close, enemies closer: the complex role of the microbiome in antitumor immunity

source_routes.paper_title: A Literature Review on the Impact of the Gut Microbiome on Cancer Treatment Efficacy, Disease Evolution and Toxicity: The Implications for Hematological Malignancies

source_routes.paper_title: Abstract 3523: A Black Raspberry dietary intervention to modify the gut microbiome and improve the response to immune checkpoint inhibitors

source_routes.paper_title: Exploring the role of the gut microbiome in modulating response to anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in melanoma patients

source_routes.paper_title: Microbial mechanisms to improve immune checkpoint blockade responsiveness

source_routes.paper_title: The Influence of Diet and Probiotics on the Response of Solid Tumours to Immunotherapy: Present and Future Perspectives

source_routes.paper_title: Role of gut microbiome on immunotherapy efficacy in melanoma

source_routes.paper_title: Obesity, cancer, and response to immune checkpoint inhibitors: Could the gut microbiota be the mechanistic link?

source_routes.paper_title: [Tracking Research Progress in the Modulatory Role of Gut Microbiome in Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors Applied in Cancer Treatment].

source_routes.paper_title: The Utilisation of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Gut microbiota reshaping the pancreatic cancer immune microenvironment: new avenues for immunotherapy

source_routes.paper_title: Effect of gut microbiota on immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) based cancer immunotherapy

source_routes.paper_title: The Evolving Landscape of Immunotoxicity: Charting Mechanisms and Future Strategies for Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Adverse Events

source_routes.paper_title: Facts and Hopes for Gut Microbiota Interventions in Cancer Immunotherapy

source_routes.paper_title: The role of the bacterial microbiome in the treatment of cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Latest evidence on clinical outcomes and prognostic factors of advanced urothelial carcinoma in the era of immune checkpoint inhibitors: a narrative review.

source_routes.paper_title: Systematic evaluation of immune regulation and modulation

source_routes.paper_title: Immune‐related adverse events of antibody‐based biological medicines in cancer therapy

source_routes.paper_title: Molecular studies on the impact of microbiome on anticancer drug resistance

source_routes.paper_title: Microbiome and cancer: mechanistic insights, diagnostic potential, and therapeutic strategies

source_routes.paper_title: Impact of influenza vaccination on survival of patients with advanced cancer receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors (INVIDIa-2): final results of the multicentre, prospective, observational study
source_routes.specific_usable_material: 提供非靶向肿瘤抗原的外部免疫刺激（流感疫苗）与 ICI 疗效关联的观察性证据，提出“旁观者效应”及免疫超激活假说。虽不直接涉及肠道菌群，但其揭示的系统性免疫激活可能非特异性增强抗肿瘤反应的机制，可作为解释其他免疫调节因素（包括微生物抗原交叉反应）的理论参照。

source_routes.paper_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated gastrointestinal adverse events in patients with colorectal cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Microbiome-selective DNA Pol IIIC inhibitors in oncology infection management
source_routes.specific_usable_material: 引入 DNA Pol IIIC 抑制剂作为区别于传统广谱抗生素的新兴类别，强调其“微生物组 sparing”特性（保留拟杆菌门和厚壁菌门）。文中指出保留微生物多样性可增强 CD8+ T 细胞激活，为解释为何某些抗生素暴露对 ICI 疗效负面影响较小及未来开发精准抗感染策略提供理论依据和对比素材。

source_routes.paper_title: Insights into the Relationship Between the Gut Microbiome and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Solid Tumors

source_routes.paper_title: Gut microbiome and serum short-chain fatty acids are associated with responses to chemo- or targeted therapies in Chinese patients with lung cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Metagenomics and culturomics reveal the dual role of the gut microbiome in the development of immune-related toxicities and the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Breakthroughs in immune checkpoint therapy: overcoming NSCLC immune checkpoint therapy resistance with novel techniques

source_routes.paper_title: Immunological Drug–Drug Interactions in Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy: Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Artificial Intelligence

source_routes.paper_title: Bacteria in cancer therapy: A new generation of weapons

source_routes.paper_title: Impact of Patient Characteristics on the Outcomes of Patients with Gastrointestinal Cancers Treated with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors

source_routes.paper_title: Microbiome Landscape and Association with Response to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Advanced Solid Tumors: A SCRUM-Japan MONSTAR-SCREEN Study

source_routes.paper_title: Abstract A14: Meta-analysis improves identification of microbiome associations with antitumor response in melanoma, lung, and kidney cancer patients treated with checkpoint inhibitors

source_routes.paper_title: Role of the intestinal microbiome and microbial-derived metabolites in immune checkpoint blockade immunotherapy of cancer

source_routes.paper_title: Gut microbiota's role in NAFLD- and HBV/HCV-related hepatocellular carcinoma: Mechanisms and therapeutic implications.

source_routes.paper_title: Microbiota: A key factor affecting and regulating the efficacy of immunotherapy

source_routes.paper_title: The gut microbiome in lung cancer: from pathogenesis to precision therapy

source_routes.paper_title: [Intestinal microbiom modulates the response to antitumor immunotherapy].
